reviews.title: Non functional. Developer constantly lies
reviews.text:
This is a live service game which frequently stops functioning for hours at a time. The developer constantly lies. They blame outages on cloud providers that are fully functional, and they blame bugs on supposed bugs in iOS that somehow don’t affect anyone other than players of this game. 

The actual game mechanics are irrelevant.  The developer is unwilling to invest the time or money to make it work.

reviews.title: Felt like the devs cared
reviews.text: This game is unique against not only RPGs but all games in general, especially on the App Store. No ads is a good start but it’s not pay to win at all, and you can play VERY casually and still make progress. My only complaint is that the sequel/sibling game is almost identical and yet there is no way to save anything between them even though almost all the mechanics are the same. I get that that is asking for a lot though, so all in all this game looks great, runs great, sounds great, and mostly importantly is free

reviews.title: Great game but…
reviews.text:
We need to be able to explore the map without gps, games practically dead in winter, living out in BFE sux = less opportunities, riding is okay, but if you move too fast you can’t buy items, fishing is a joke, being limited to one character means no making new characters, wouldn’t mind paying .99 for additional character slots, with that shared stash would be cool.  .99 stash tabs.  No ads, wouldn’t mind paying .99 to remove ads.  
So many opportunities to make additional money with game, but it needs some improvement for it to make sense.  
Also, having some skill hotkeys would be cool and then having a skill list would be cool while in battle.  
With a few twists this game could be ballin.

reviews.title: Good Game
reviews.text:
Hello GM
The game is really great; I spent 100 hours playing it continuously over several days, but I have some suggestions for improvement

- I suggest adding an auto-battle feature and a 2x speed mode for battles. 

- I suggest adding a function to automatically optimize RAM, battery, and graphics based on the phone configuration. 

- I suggest adding new character classes and new skills, such as Beast Tamer, Sword Mage, etc. 

- I suggest adding random events that occur at different time frames. 

- I suggest adding life skills and secondary professions
+ Life skills: Hunting, Fishing, Foraging, etc.
+ Secondary professions: Blacksmith, Tailor, Healer, Chef, etc. 

- I also suggest adding a sleep function to save battery for the phone

- I also add offline features to the game, including when walking and still not turning on wifi, the number of steps is still counted

- I also suggest adding a character function that automatically fights monsters within the circle

- I also suggest adding a feature where defeating monsters can yield materials for crafting items, potions, and cooking. 

- I also hope for new equipment and items, new characters and skills, new Pet, new events and quests, new map areas, new monsters and bosses.
